mapper.select: SELECT connection_id, revision FROM ai_application_integration WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND application_id = #{appId} AND del_flag = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_application_integration (id, tenant_id, application_id, create_by, create_dept, update_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{appId}, #{userId}, #{deptId}, #{userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id

INSERT INTO ai_application_capability (id, tenant_id, application_id, capability_id, create_by, create_dept, update_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{appId}, #{capabilityId}, #{userId}, #{deptId}, #{userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT capability_id FROM ai_application_capability WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND application_id = #{appId} AND capability_id = #{capabilityId} AND del_flag = 0

SELECT c.* FROM ai_capability c INNER JOIN ai_application_capability a ON a.capability_id = c.id AND a.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND a.del_flag = 0 WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.application_id = #{appId} AND c.del_flag = 0
AND (c.capability_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.capability_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY c.update_time DESC, c.id DESC
